# NEURA structural fixtures

These fixtures describe **structure only**: robots rules, sitemap URLs and link shapes observed during the 2026-09-26 read-only review (docs/discovery/NEURA_STRUCTURAL_REVIEW_2026-09-26.md).
- `robots.txt` is the file as served.
- `reservation-page-links.html` holds the link shapes of the 4NE1 reservation page.
- `product-sitemap.xml` and `news.html` are reduced to their `<loc>` entries and links, plus placeholder text.

There are no prices, specifications, product copy or commercial facts. Page `<h1>`/body text is synthetic.
